```yaml
name: Devx Version Tag Automation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  devx-tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Get latest release tag
        id: get_latest_release
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=latest_release::$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-rl/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name' | sed 's/v//')"

      - name: Find highest devX tag
        id: find_highest_devx_tag
        run: |
          latest_release=${{ steps.get_latest_release.outputs.latest_release }}
          highest_devx_tag=$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${latest_release}.dev*" | cut -d'/' -f3 | sort -V | tail -n1)
          if [[ -z $highest_devx_tag ]]; then
            highest_devx_tag="${latest_release}.dev0"
          fi
          echo "::set-output name=highest_devx_tag::$highest_devx_tag"

      - name: Create next devX tag
        id: create_next_devx_tag
        run: |
          highest_devx_tag=${{ steps.find_highest_devx_tag.outputs.highest_devx_tag }}
          next_devx_tag=$(echo $highest_devx_tag | awk -F'.dev' '{print $1 ".dev" ($2+1)}')
          git tag $next_devx_tag
          git push origin $next_devx_tag

      - name: Retry on tag collision
        if: failure()
        run: |
          attempts=5
          delay=5
          while ((attempts-- > 0)); do
            git tag ${{ steps.create_next_devx_tag.outputs.next_devx_tag }} || sleep $delay
            if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/tags/$${steps.create_next_devx_tag.outputs.next_devx_tag}}; then
              break
            fi
          done
```
